pre_registered_gate.G2_significance: bootstrap 95% CI on ROI excludes zero (5000 resamples, seed 20261114)
pre_registered_gate.G3_multiple_testing: Benjamini-Hochberg FDR at q=0.1 across all strategies evaluated
pre_registered_gate.G4_holdout_sign: holdout seasons [2024, 2025, 2026] must show the same sign as in-sample
pre_registered_gate.G5_price_basis: at least 50% of bets priced from a recorded spread/total price; the rest fall back to -110 and that share is reported

note_on_search: The number of strategies tried is published deliberately. Testing many candidates and reporting only the best is the standard way an illusory edge is manufactured.

blocked.name: Player-prop singles
blocked.reason: No historical player-prop PRICES in this repository (question Q02).

blocked.name: Player-prop combos / same-game parlays
blocked.reason: Needs prop prices (Q02) AND prop-leg correlations (Q05). Publishing either without the other would be an unverified pricing claim.

blocked.name: Cross-game parlays
blocked.reason: Testable in principle once a leg-level price history exists; the closing file gives side prices for spreads but not for every combination.

price_sources.note: closing_lines.csv holds spread/total prices for part of the sample only, and does not record which book or timestamp (Q01). Where no price exists the standard -110 is used and the coverage share is shown per strategy.

caveats: Default -110 pricing is used where the schedule file carries no side price; a real account would face different prices and limits.
No stake sizing, bankroll rule or line-shopping is modelled.
The holdout seasons are the most recent three, but they were also used to build the descriptive pages, so they are not pristine. This is stated rather than hidden.
A strategy that fails G2 may still be real but underpowered; failing the gate means 'not yet demonstrated', not 'proven false'.
